notes: High-level: Velaris runs a global CX platform used by mid+enterprise clients. Primary initiative is ticket deflection and auto-assist for agents. Current infra: Elastic + application-layer embeddings (home-grown) + a lightweight neural reranker used synchronously. Scale: ~3M unique tickets, 4M technical docs/KB articles, daily delta ~8k docs. Goals: reduce human handle time by 30%, increase automated deflection to 45% for top-tier customers, maintain agent-facing latency SLOs: end-to-end retrieval+rerank <= 180ms median, 99th < 450ms (target 150ms median for select routes). Precision targets: P@5 >= 0.80, MRR@5 improvement >= 18% vs baseline. Cost target: blended per-query (embedding + index + rerank) < $0.02 for high-volume routes; willing to trade small latency increase for cost savings. Technical preferences: vector index with HNSW/FAISS, hybrid sparse+dense scoring, incremental indexing (streaming ingest), low-latency reranker (distil BERT or 8-bit LLaMA variant), ability to colocate vector store with inference runtime to avoid cross-region hops. Must support encrypted-in-transit and KMS-managed keys. Data residency: US and EU splits; legal requires audit logs for queries and retention controls. POC asks: replicate 3M ticket index, run live traffic shadowing for 72h, measure top-5 precision and latency p50/p95/p99. Notes from call: "We need deterministic tail latency — even occasional 700ms spikes break agent workflow." AE notes: prefer dedicated GPU pool; SE recommends dedicated for reranker and hosted vector store within VPC peered network. Ask for a cost projection (qps 2000 sustained, bursts 6k) and index sharding strategy. Also request recommended batching/caching profile (prefix caching, user session affinity).
